author: Gio1498
quote: A game running at an unstable 30 fps in 2026 is ridiculous, and all of this just because, as usual, the game has to be a console exclusive at launch, forcing people with a good PC to play it at 30 fps if they're lucky. Plus, it's full of bugs, you just have to take a quick look on YouTube to see what I'm talking about. After a 13-year wait it's ridiculous, but the most ridiculous thing of all are the gaming outlets giving it a perfect score despite all these issues. Shame on you.

author: Gio1498
quote: There's no way a game like this could be released in 2025 and have such high ratings. It's technically obscene, the graphics are outdated and the drawn-on balconies on the houses are the icing on the cake. It's also poorly optimized. The only good thing about the game is the combat system. I hope Gamefreak wakes up and releases a Pokémon game worthy of its name.
